tagDescription: Search video content from a large independent index of web pages.

authParams.name: x-subscription-token
authParams.description: The subscription token that was generated for the product.

schema.title: Subscription token
schema.description: The subscription token that was generated for the product.

schema.title: API version
schema.description: The API version to use. This is denoted by the format YYYY-MM-DD. Default is the latest that is available. Read more about API versioning.

headerParams.name: accept
headerParams.description: The default supported media type is application/json.

schema.title: Media type
schema.description: The default supported media type is application/json.

headerParams.name: cache-control
headerParams.description: Brave Search will return cached content by default. To prevent caching set the Cache-Control header to no-cache. This is currently done as best effort.

schema.title: Cache control
schema.description: Brave Search will return cached content by default. To prevent caching set the Cache-Control header to no-cache. This is currently done as best effort.

headerParams.name: user-agent
headerParams.description: The user agent originating the request. Brave search can utilize the user agent to provide a different experience depending on the device as described by the string. The user agent should follow the commonly used browser agent strings on each platform. For more information on curating user agents, see RFC 9110.

schema.title: User agent

The user agent should follow the commonly used browser agent strings on each platform. For more information on curating user agents, see RFC 9110.

id.title: Id
id.description: A unique identifier for this particular occurrence of the problem.

status.title: Status
status.description: The HTTP status code applicable to this problem, expressed as a string value.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. Like title, this field’s value can be localized.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: A meta object containing non-standard meta-information about the error.

code.description: An application-specific error code, expressed as a string value.

applied.title: Applied
applied.description: Whether search operators were applied to the query.

cleaned_query.title: Cleaned Query
cleaned_query.description: The query after search operators have been processed.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: List of site domains extracted from site: operators.

results.title: Results
results.description: The list of video results for the given query.

extra.description: Additional information about the video search results.

q.title: Q
q.description: The user’s search query term. Query can not be empty. Maximum of 400 characters and 50 words in the query.

search_lang.description: The search language preference. The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided.

ui_lang.description: User interface language preferred in response. Usually of the format <language_code>-<country_code>. For more, see RFC 9110.

country.description: The search query country, where the results come from. The country string is limited to 2 character country codes of supported countries or ALL for worldwide.

safesearch.title: Safe search
safesearch.description:
Filters search results for adult content. The following values are supported:

  • off - No filtering is done.
  • moderate - Filters explicit content, like images and videos, but allows adult domains in the search results.
  • strict - Drops all adult content from search results.

count.title: Count
count.description: The number of search results returned in response. The maximum is 50. The actual number delivered may be less than requested. Combine this parameter with offset to paginate search results.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: The zero based offset that indicates number of search results per page (count) to skip before returning the result. The maximum is 9. The actual number delivered may be less than requested based on the query. In order to paginate results use this parameter together with count. For example, if your user interface displays 20 search results per page, set count to 20 and offset to 0 to show the first page of results. To get subsequent pages, increment offset by 1 (e.g. 0, 1, 2). The results may overlap across multiple pages.

spellcheck.title: Spellcheck
spellcheck.description: Whether to spell check the provided query. If the spellchecker is enabled, the modified query is always used for search. The modified query can be found in altered key from the query response model.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.description:
Filters search results by page age. The age of a page is determined by the most relevant date reported by the content, such as its published or last modified date. The following values are supported:

  • pd - Pages aged 24 hours or less.
  • pw - Pages aged 7 days or less.
  • pm - Pages aged 31 days or less.
  • py - Pages aged 365 days or less.
  • YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD - A custom date range is also supported by specifying start and end dates e.g. 2022-04-01to2022-07-30.

might_be_offensive.title: Might Be Offensive
might_be_offensive.description: Indicates whether the video search results might contain offensive content.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The protocol scheme extracted from the URL.

netloc.title: Netloc
netloc.description: The network location part extracted from the URL.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: The lowercased domain name extracted from the URL.

favicon.title: Favicon
favicon.description: The favicon used for the URL.

path.title: Path
path.description: The hierarchical path of the URL useful as a display string.

url.title: Url
url.description: The original URL where the profile is available.

long_name.title: Long Name
long_name.description: The long name of the profile.

img.title: Img
img.description: The served image URL representing the profile.

original.title: Original
original.description: The original query that was requested.

altered.title: Altered
altered.description: The altered query by the spellchecker. This is the query that is used to search if any.

cleaned.title: Cleaned
cleaned.description: The cleaned normalized query by the spellchecker. This is the query that is used to search if any.

spellcheck_off.title: Spellcheck Off
spellcheck_off.description: Whether the spellchecker is enabled or disabled.

show_strict_warning.title: Show Strict Warning
show_strict_warning.description: The value is true if the lack of results is due to a strict safesearch setting. Adult content relevant to the query was found, but was blocked by safesearch.

search_operators.description: Search operators applied to the query.

src.title: Src
src.description: The served URL of the thumbnail associated with the video.

original.title: Original
original.description: The original URL of the thumbnail associated with the video.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: A time string representing the duration of the video.

views.title: Views
views.description: The number of views of the video.

requires_subscription.title: Requires Subscription
requires_subscription.description: Whether the video requires a subscription.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: A list of tags relevant to the video.

author.description: A profile associated with the video.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of video search API result. The value is always video_result.

url.title: Url
url.description: The source URL of the video.

age.title: Age
age.description: A human-readable representation of the video’s age. For example, 2 days ago.

page_age.title: Page Age
page_age.description: The page’s date, based on its published or last modified date.

page_fetched.title: Page Fetched
page_fetched.description: The ISO date time when the page was last fetched. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

fetched_content_timestamp.title: Fetched Content Timestamp
fetched_content_timestamp.description: The timestamp when the content was fetched.

meta_url.description: Aggregated information on the URL associated with the video search result.
